localReplay.reason: Replay completo exigido no CI deste commit antes da aplicação em produção.

cliConstraint: Supabase db push applies the pending migration tail in order and has no per-file include flag.
releaseConditions: Every migration in the contiguous tail receives an explicit production disposition.
Tenant-specific migrations are proven no-op when their synthetic tenant is absent.
AI controls remain disabled and the kill switch remains active.
A clean replay and the full database suite pass on the exact release commit.
Production dry-run must list exactly the currently reviewed pending tail; historical counts do not authorize this release.
Fresh encrypted backup and Cardápio restore drill pass before db push.
Postgres 15.19/17.11 checks for ltree, btree_gist, legacy pgcrypto and custom operators are recorded.
Security and performance advisors have no unaccepted critical finding.
Technical and business owners explicitly authorize the release window.
authorizationSource: Pedido do responsável nesta conversa para concluir, testar e publicar a jornada funcional do Cardápio.
authorizationScope: Correção preserve_menu_special_hours e jornada de criação e gestão do Cardápio.
